name: Li-Chun Lu
now: following the agent debates this term
vibe: Follows how the class builds and argues about agents, and picks up ideas along the way.
lines: Hi, I'm Li-Chun! I'm in the class this term, following the agent debates.
Every week someone shows an agent I didn't expect. It's a fun room to be in.
My class site is still just a welcome page, so I'm keeping things simple.
I like hearing how people grade their agents, and what fails along the way.
No group for me this week. I'm happy to wander between tables and listen.
chatter: ooh, how did they grade that?
